questions.q: How many rounds is a modern world title fight?
questions.e: Championship distance was cut from fifteen in the 1980s.

questions.q: How long is a professional round for men?
questions.e: Three minutes with a one-minute rest between rounds.

questions.q: What does TKO stand for?
questions.e: The referee stops the contest without a full count.

questions.q: How many seconds does a referee count for a knockdown?
questions.e: A boxer who fails to rise by ten is knocked out.

questions.q: What is the standard scoring system for a round won clearly?
questions.e: A knockdown usually makes it 10-8.

questions.q: What is a split decision?
o: Two judges favour one boxer and one the other
questions.e: A unanimous decision has all three judges agreeing.

questions.q: Which blow is illegal in boxing?
questions.e: Low blows can cost a point or bring disqualification.

questions.q: What is a clinch?
o: Holding an opponent to stop their work
questions.e: The referee separates fighters who clinch excessively.

questions.q: Which is the heaviest professional division?
questions.e: Heavyweight has no upper limit.

questions.q: What is the traditional weight limit for welterweight?
questions.e: About 66.7 kilograms.

questions.q: Which division sits directly below heavyweight?
questions.e: Cruiserweight was created in 1979.

questions.q: What is the middleweight limit?
questions.e: Around 72.6 kilograms.

questions.q: What does undisputed champion mean?
o: Holding every major sanctioning body's belt in a division
Winning twenty fights in a row
questions.e: Currently the WBA, WBC, IBF and WBO titles.

questions.q: Which of these is a major sanctioning body?
questions.e: The World Boxing Council, founded in 1963.

questions.q: What happens if a boxer misses weight at the weigh-in?
o: They may forfeit the title or face a penalty
questions.e: A champion who misses weight can lose the belt on the scales.

questions.q: What is pound for pound ranking?
o: A hypothetical ranking of the best boxers regardless of weight
questions.e: It compares fighters across divisions.

questions.q: Which boxer said float like a butterfly, sting like a bee?
questions.e: Ali won the heavyweight title three times.

questions.q: What was the name of the 1974 Ali versus Foreman fight in Zaire?
questions.e: Ali regained the title using the rope-a-dope.

questions.q: Which heavyweight retired undefeated at 49-0?
questions.e: Marciano retired as champion in 1956.

questions.q: Which boxer became the youngest heavyweight champion at twenty?
questions.e: Tyson beat Trevor Berbick in 1986.

questions.q: Which Filipino won world titles in eight different weight divisions?
questions.e: No other boxer has managed eight.

questions.q: Which American retired with a 50-0 professional record?
questions.e: He surpassed Marciano's mark in 2017.

questions.q: Which heavyweight held the title through the 1930s and 1940s for a record reign?
questions.e: Louis defended the title 25 times.

questions.q: Which fighter was known as Sugar Ray and is often rated the finest ever?
questions.e: Robinson dominated welterweight and middleweight from the 1940s.
